correctness.rationale: Four orthogonal spectral projectors give exact five entry types. Strict offdiagonal sign is a positive factorization; each diagonal sign is exactly that of an explicit quartic. The scalar Radau global minimum yields positivity below 12 vertices. At 12 or more, rational witnesses at h=8/q and 8/p force the two respective diagonals negative; the positive quadratic certificate has discriminant -128(25n^2+480n-8712)<0. Descartes gives exactly two distinct positive zeros per quartic. Exact rational root isolations prove disjoint intervals on K_{2,10} and overlapping intervals on K_{5,7}. A standalone independent full-matrix rational inverter verifies 30768 finite assertions, not used as proof of infinity.

value.rationale: The exact graph-specific endpoint nonnegativity domain is a natural numerical ODE invariant relevant to diffusion/concentration preservation. Two separately rooted quartics give a complete all-parameters classification for unequal bipartite networks; isolated examples establish that the safety domain has either two or three separated components. The universal 12-vertex threshold is a sharp structural boundary but the core value beyond the prior balanced theorem is the new double-interval phase structure and its constructive exact step-size test.
